name: Apocalypse Rush Racing
summary:
Apocalypse Rush Racing is a high-octane VR combat racing experience set in the ruins of an abandoned nuclear power plant, shattered by disaster and crawling with zombies. What was once a symbol of power is now a deadly battleground where speed, firepower, and survival collide.
